messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - Elevated 429s detected (tenant=ironclad) in dedicated pool d-pool-17. Spike started ~10m ago. Auto-throttle engaged.

pager: paging maria (oncall-sre) :rotating_light:

maria (oncall-sre): picking up. I see the page. pulling logs now. anyone already looked at pool metrics?

ben (eng-runtime): i started a quick dashboard. d-pool-17 steady GPU util ~78%, but per-tenant token qps for ironclad jumped x12. kernel queueing rising.

maria (oncall-sre): ok looks like it's not whole pool saturation. it's noisy-tenant behaviour -> our fairshare started firing and returning 429s. need to know if this is legitimate traffic or a runaway job. eli, are they running a new batch?

eli (cust-success): pinged Ironclad CS lead (on email). they say a deployment rolled today that increases sampling. they think it's expected but under contract they have higher burst allowance. will confirm but asked for possible temporary relief.

maria (oncall-sre): can we do a soft mitigation: 1) isolate tenant to a carved subpool 2) or temporarily raise their per-second quota while we validate. what's fastest?

samir (infra): fastest is to apply a token-level override in the control plane to bump their qps. carving a subpool requires casting a short job to reprovision and move their assignments — ~8-12m.

ben (eng-runtime): we also have model-fallback option. route their requests to a lower-cost compatible variant (smaller model) to reduce token time. but that changes output quality.

jessica (acct-mgr): if we grant emergency quota it's a contract exception. need verbal approval from revenue/sales. eli, can you get a quick ack that they'd accept a temporary surcharge?

eli (cust-success): on it. cs is on call with their infra lead now. they asked for a 30m emergency lift while they throttle at their end.

maria (oncall-sre): runbook options: (A) apply admin override + monitor (B) carve subpool + mig (C) temporarily route to fallback model. I'd prefer A then C if traffic persists. A gives immediate relief.

ben (eng-runtime): steps for A: run admin API (internal) to set token override. snippet:

```
POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/admin/overrides
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tenant": "ironclad",
  "token": "tk_iron_01",
  "override_type": "rate",
  "qps": 50,
  "expires_in": 1800,
  "reason": "Emergency lift - coordinated with CS"
}
```

ben (eng-runtime): after POST check `/admin/overrides/{id}` then `GET /metrics/pool/d-pool-17?tenant=ironclad` to verify 429s fall.

maria (oncall-sre): i'll run the override if we have verbal OK from jessica or revenue. eli, status?

eli (cust-success): cs confirms customer accepts surcharge and will throttle from their side. they want the override now.

jessica (acct-mgr): verbal ok from sales. logging approval in CRM. proceed. :+1:

maria (oncall-sre): applying override now.

maria (oncall-sre): ran override. response: 200 OK. override_id=ovr-9123.

maria (oncall-sre): monitoring metrics... 2m... 429s dropping from ~400/min to ~22/min. tokens/sec for ironclad at target 45 qps.

ben (eng-runtime): good signal. still seeing elevated latency p95 +30ms but acceptable.

samir (infra): queue depth is decreasing. recommend carving subpool as follow-up if they plan sustained higher traffic. I'll prep split plan.

eli (cust-success): customer confirms they rolled back the internal ramp for now and will coordinate a controlled test later this afternoon. they asked to keep the override for 30m.

maria (oncall-sre): set automatic expiry at 30m. I'll keep monitoring until handoff. leaving notes: override_id=ovr-9123, created by maria, expires-in=1800s.

ben (eng-runtime): follow-up actions (owner):
- samir: plan pool carve-out (d-pool-17 -> d-pool-17a for ironclad) and estimate downtime/traffic migration (ETA 45m).
- ben: prepare model-fallback policy in case we need to reduce cost/latency for long run.
- jessica/eli: confirm contract amendment if they want persistent higher burst.
- maria: document incident and validate monitoring alerts don't auto-page for known override event.

samir (infra): i'm starting the carve plan. will post commands here before executing.

maria (oncall-sre): quick note: created incident ticket RED-INC-2025-0478 and linked override id. tagging follow-ups.

eli (cust-success): customer flagged they will run a controlled test at T+2h. they want a subpool by then if possible.

maria (oncall-sre): handoff in 30m to night oncall. leaving context in incident ticket. current state: 429s reduced, override active, customer stabilized.

jessica (acct-mgr): logged billing exception. finance notified.

ben (eng-runtime): small TIP: add a temporary rule to routing policy to prefer dedicated spare nodes for ironclad until subpool exists. fallback config:

```
route_rule {
  tenant = "ironclad"
  prefer_pool = "d-pool-17-spare"
  max_retries = 2
}
```

samir (infra): prepping migration commands. won't cut until we confirm low impact.

maria (oncall-sre): last check before handoff - 429s steady ~10/min. overrider_id=ovr-9123. leaving page open until samir confirms carve scheduled. handoff in 25m to dawn oncall. tagging @pager.

incident-bot: Note: Pager escalation suppressed for overridden token ovr-9123 until expiry.

maria (oncall-sre): handing off to night oncall (ben) in 20m. will post a final update when carve is scheduled.

ben (eng-runtime): i'll take next shift. thanked. will coordinate carve with samir and CS.

eli (cust-success): customer says thanks. they'll keep a closer eye on ramp plan.

maria (oncall-sre): closing active remediation. keep thread for postmortem notes. we should add a short runbook snippet for enterprise burst exception flow.

jessica (acct-mgr): agreed. i'll start the worksheet for contract amendment.

samir (infra): carve plan posted in ops-docs. scheduling migration window 40m from now. will announce separately.

maria (oncall-sre): final: change in metrics: 429 rate dropped 98% vs peak. closing incident for active page. re-open if it spikes again. :white_check_mark:
